# Healthcare claims platform — developer view; ASP.NET Core services, FastAPI ML pipelines, Java payer-integration — JetBrains Guidelines

Project guidelines for JetBrains Junie and AI Assistant. Generated by EmbedIQ from an adaptive Q&A — keep in sync with the rest of the repository configuration.

## Stack

- Languages: csharp, python, java
- Frameworks: .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core / Entity Framework Core / FastAPI / Spring Boot
- Build: dotnet, pip, maven
- Testing: xunit, pytest, junit
- CI/CD: azure_devops
- Cloud: azure

## Commands

- Install: `pip install -r requirements.txt`
- Test: `pytest`

## Boundaries

Hard constraints that override general preferences.

- HIPAA: never include PHI (names, MRNs, DOBs, dates of service) in code, comments, logs, or test data.
- Never hardcode secrets, API keys, passwords, or session tokens.

## Rules

- Run tests before committing any change; do not skip failing tests.
- Keep changes scoped to the task — avoid drive-by refactors unless requested.
- Prefer editing existing files; do not create new files unless necessary.
- Python: PEP 8; type hints on all signatures; f-strings for formatting.
- Java: records for value types; `Optional` instead of null returns; sealed hierarchies.

## Terminology

- PHI: Protected Health Information — any identifier linked to health data.
- BAA: Business Associate Agreement — required contract with HIPAA-covered entities.
- Healthcare claims platform — developer view; ASP.NET Core services, FastAPI ML pipelines, Java payer-integration: the business domain this repository implements.
